simple.meaning: שִׁפְחָה (shiphchâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a female slave (as a member of the household).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 12:16. The surrounding context includes land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁפְחָה (H8198) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: a female slave (as a member of the household)
definitions.full: H8198. shiphchah שִׁפְחָה noun feminine maid, maid-servant (synonym אָמָה , q. v.; originally = concubine ? compare √); — absolute ׳שׁ Gen 16:1 +; construct שִׁפְחַת 16:2 +; suffix שִׁפְחָתִי 16:2 +, etc.; plural absolute שְׁפָחוֺת 12:16 +; suffix שִׁפְחֹתֶ֑ךָ Ruth 2:13 , etc.; — 1 literally, maid, maid-servant , as belonging to a mistress Gen 16:1 , 3 , 6 , 8 (PJ) 29:24 ; 29:29 (P) Psa 123:2 ; Prov 30:23 ; Isa 24:2 ; even where concubine of master (compare אָמָה ) Gen 16:2 , 5 (PJ) 25:12 ; 35:25-26 , (P) 30:4 , 7 , 9 , 10 , 12 , 18 (all J E); less often reference to master 29:24 , 29 (J), Ruth 2:13 , of concubine Gen 32:23 , compare 33:1-2 , 6 (all J); marriageable Lev 19:20 (H, compare Exod 11:5 ; not elsewhere in legisl.); in General, especially of menial service (never אָמָה ) 11:5 (J) 1Sam 25:41 (opposed to אָמָה ) 2Sam 17:17 (|| עֶבֶד ) Gen 12:16 ; 24:35 (J) 20:14 (E) 30:43 (P) 32:6 (J; collective) Deut 28:68 ; 1Sam 8:16 ; 2Kin 5:26 ; Isa 14:2 ; Jer 34:9-10 , 11 (twice in verse); 34:16 (twice in verse); Joel 3:2 ; Eccl 2:7 ; 2Chr 28:10 ; Est 7:4 . 2 figurative in address , שִׁפְחָֽתְךָ , etc., of speaker, in token of humility (see אָמָה ) Ruth 2:13 (|| אָמָה 3:9 ), 1Sam 1:18 (|| id. 1:16 ), 25:27 , (|| 25:24 f.), 28:21-22 , 2Sam 14:6-7 , 12 (twice in verse); 14:15 , 17 , 19 ; (|| אָמָה 14:15 ; 14:16 ); 2Kin 4:2 , 16 ; not toward God; but see אָמָה .
definitions.rootNote: feminine from an unused root meaning to spread out (as a family; see 4940 );
